Speculation on Sam Bradford's potential as an Eagle

While he was with the Rams I didn't get to see Bradford play very much, but now that he's standing directly in the path of Cowboys playoff runs I'm trying to study up on him. Those of you who are familiar with him, what should we expect to see out of him in 2015?

To be honest the prospect of Bradford and Chip Kelly coming together has the potential to be a beautiful union. Just look at what Kelly was able to get out of Nick Foles (admittedly only for a brief period but still) and now imagine what he can do with a Qb with the sort of accuracy that Bradford can hopefully bring to the table.

Bradford has always been one of those guys who I felt just needed the right personnel around and behind him to make something magical happen. Now that he is away from that absolute clusterfuck that is the Rams and assuming that he can stay healthy, this could be a very exciting season for the Eagles.

Yeah, Bradford has shown definite talent and potential, and Chip is a wildcard. I'm just glad that I don't have to worry about him throwing to Jackson or Maclin, it's going to be painful enough watching him hand off to Murray.
If gets healthy by the time the season starts he could definitely be a top-10 QB.

"Trust me when I tell you he's got all the skills, and I keep going back to the fierce competitor because I believe elite quarterbacks in this league have that," Spagnuolo said in May. "You think of them all, the Aaron Rodgers, the Tom Bradys, the Peyton Mannings, Eli Mannings..."

One of these is not like the others.

I always thought Bradford had the talent to be borderline top-10 (like Flacco or Ryan level) so if he stays healthy I'd say around there, and maybe even a bit more efficient due to Chip's offense and his athleticism, along with the running threat the Eagles have to keep defenses honest

Admittedly, I was upset when we initially picked up Bradford, but the guy's grown on me. He has killer accuracy, and with this QB friendly offence that helped an aging Mike Vick, mediocre Foles (I'd guess he performs somewhere between 2014 and 2013 form, closer to the '14, though) , and Butt Fumble Sanchez all achieve success. Bradford, from what I've seen is a better quarterback than all of them. Provided he can stay healthy, I would be surprised if he wasn't in the top 10.

Fuck that.

Hopefully voat let's the organic nature of the community thrive under its own energy.
